title: Premium Rating Scale for the Travel Protection Plans Range
content:
## 1. Basis of charge

1.1 The premium of a Travel Protection Plans certificate is built from the plan's base premium rate, its flat annual premium, its minimum premium and its policy issue fee. The base premium rate is stated as a percentage of the declared trip cost. The flat annual premium is the amount charged on a multi-trip plan, in USD. The minimum premium is the smallest premium the plan may be issued for, in USD. The policy fee is the non-refundable issue fee of the certificate, in USD.

1.2 A single-trip plan carries a base premium rate and no annual premium; a multi-trip plan carries an annual premium and no base premium rate. On every plan the minimum premium and the policy fee stand at the figures scheduled below.

## 2. Scale of charges

| Plan | Base premium rate, per cent of declared trip cost | Flat annual premium, USD | Minimum premium, USD | Policy fee, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 4.2 | 0.00 | 39.00 | 12.00 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 5.4 | 0.00 | 55.00 | 12.00 |
| TripGuard Plus | 6.8 | 0.00 | 79.00 | 15.00 |
| TripGuard Premier | 8.5 | 0.00 | 109.00 | 15.00 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 11.9 | 0.00 | 169.00 | 25.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 0.0 | 289.00 | 289.00 | 25.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 0.0 | 649.00 | 649.00 | 35.00 |

## 3. Reading the scale

3.1 The same figure serves twice on a multi-trip plan: the flat annual premium and the minimum premium are one and the same amount, so 289.00 on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller and 649.00 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive are the single figure the plan is charged.

3.2 The five single-trip plans rise in rate and in floor together: Trip Basics Essential at 4.2 per cent with a floor of 39.00, Trip Basics Standard at 5.4 per cent with a floor of 55.00, TripGuard Plus at 6.8 per cent with a floor of 79.00, TripGuard Premier at 8.5 per cent with a floor of 109.00, and Cancel For Any Reason Elite at 11.9 per cent with a floor of 169.00.

3.3 The policy fee follows the plan and not the size of the party: it stands at 12.00 on both Trip Basics plans, 15.00 on both TripGuard plans, 25.00 on Cancel For Any Reason Elite and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and 35.00 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive.
